Record Class QwenModelArgs

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
smile.llm.model.qwen.QwenModelArgs
Record Components:
dim - token embedding / hidden size.
numLayers - number of hybrid decoder blocks.
numHeads - number of query attention heads (full-attn layers).
numKvHeads - number of key/value heads (full-attn layers).
headDim - attention head dimension (may differ from dim/numHeads).
vocabSize - vocabulary size.
intermediateSize - SwiGLU FFN hidden size.
normEps - RMSNorm epsilon.
ropeTheta - RoPE base theta.
partialRotaryFactor - fraction of headDim rotated by RoPE.
linearConvKernelDim - Gated DeltaNet causal conv kernel size.
linearKeyHeadDim - DeltaNet key head dimension.
linearValueHeadDim - DeltaNet value head dimension.
linearNumKeyHeads - DeltaNet key head count.
linearNumValueHeads - DeltaNet value head count.
layerTypes - per-layer mixer type (linear_attention or full_attention).
maxBatchSize - maximum inference batch size.
maxSeqLen - maximum sequence length.
mtpNumHiddenLayers - native MTP draft layers (0 = none).
defaultNumSpeculativeTokens - default draft depth when speculation is enabled.
public record QwenModelArgs(int dim, int numLayers, int numHeads, int numKvHeads, int headDim, int vocabSize, int intermediateSize, double normEps, double ropeTheta, double partialRotaryFactor, int linearConvKernelDim, int linearKeyHeadDim, int linearValueHeadDim, int linearNumKeyHeads, int linearNumValueHeads, String[] layerTypes, int maxBatchSize, int maxSeqLen, int mtpNumHiddenLayers, int defaultNumSpeculativeTokens) extends Record
Qwen3.5 dense hybrid text-tower hyperparameters.

    • fromHuggingFace

      public static QwenModelArgs fromHuggingFace(String path, int maxBatchSize, int maxSeqLen) throws IOException
      Loads hyperparameters from a HuggingFace config.json. Accepts either a top-level text config (qwen3_5_text) or a multimodal wrapper with nested text_config.
      Parameters:
      path - path to config.json.
      maxBatchSize - maximum batch size.
      maxSeqLen - maximum sequence length; <= 0 derives from max_position_embeddings in the config.
      Returns:
      model args.
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read.
